name: Akanksha Dhawan
quote: A loud appreciation and tons of gratitude for the healing guidance and support from Malavika, especially during a personal downfall. Divinely, she came into my life at the exact point I needed her, and in just a few sessions I could see the magic. The stress and anxiety vanished, I reclaimed my power and started doing big things, I completed the healing certification myself and am now a certified healer, handling everything at work and in personal life with ease. Along with being an IT consultant and a fashion model, I'm now an author as well. Healing actually brings you back, that's my experience with Malavika.
